currentQualification.purpose: Continuous microphone capture and wake-driven emblem presence; supersedes prior turn-release and idle-timeout behavior.
currentQualification.physicalStartup: Actual native application automatically acquired one live physical microphone track; foreground remained inactive and emblem exploded. Final clean production app also showed Microphone on and Listening for Ivy.
currentQualification.method: Kokoro WAV fixtures fed through Web Audio in the actual native WebView with real local Whisper, Ivy/Terra and native speech playback. RAF sampled foreground/emblem presence; wrappers observed capture ownership and submission boundaries.

automatedVerification.lintTestBuild: Nx run-many passed for the eight affected projects and dependencies.
automatedVerification.nativeSmoke: Production embedded WebView shell, computed styles and versioned IPC passed. Initial attempt failed WebView initialization while a diagnostic instance shared the profile with different browser flags; passed after closing that owned instance and rerunning.

limitations: Physical capture startup is verified; speech fixtures are synthetic. No physical speech-accuracy, speaker-audibility or acoustic false-accept-rate claim.

Wake presence starts when an exact leading Ivy transcript is detected. An early I.V. preview was correctly rejected; the later valid preview activated before dispatch but after this fixture ended. No subsecond or before-utterance-end native guarantee.
Recognition input remains gated during thinking and Ivy playback even though the physical microphone stream remains open; this is not barge-in.
Private fixtures and detailed receipts stay in ignored artifacts; no user audio is included.

historicalQualification.note: Historical pre-clarification evidence. Its physical turn-release, reacquisition and final E2E retry results describe the earlier implementation only.
historicalQualification.method: Synthesized Kokoro speech fed through Web Audio in an isolated actual Tauri WebView; real local Whisper, cleanup, Ivy and speech playback boundaries.
historicalQualification.build: Angular development diagnostic embedded in native executable; production build and IPC smoke verified separately.

localRecognitionDurationMs.note: Single synthetic observations; excludes utterance settlement, not latency percentiles.

automatedVerification.browserResult: Full run passed before final refinements; final rerun passed 28/29 with all voice tests passing. Unrelated exact serialized camera-matrix comparison differed in tiny perspective decimals and passed its isolated retry.
automatedVerification.lintAndBuild: Affected desktop, adapter, molecule and organism checks passed; desktop E2E lint passed without warnings.
automatedVerification.nativeSmoke: Actual embedded WebView, styles and versioned IPC passed.

limitations: No physical microphone, Windows indicator, speaker audibility or acoustic false-accept-rate claim.
Wake detection waits for local utterance transcription; no dedicated acoustic detector or subsecond wake guarantee.
Cleanup admitted before cancellation cannot be undone; cancellation aborts its frontend result and never adds final cleanup or dispatch.
Native spoken suffix cancellation was exercised in the first run; buffered standalone cancellation and Terra gating were repeated on the final build.
Private fixtures and detailed synthetic receipts remain under ignored artifacts; no user audio is included.
